universal_rules: Only the owning Google Drive project/company record supplies private factual values.
Historical contracts are source precedents, never automatic legal authority.
Never transfer rates, names, exclusions or signatures between projects.
Fail closed for missing source, arithmetic mismatch, unreviewed public/private exposure.
Draft compile success is not legal/engineering correctness.
Human legal/finance/engineering approval remains independent of technical tests.

Client-facing LaTeX prose and rendered PDFs must not contain AI, database, programming, model or internal workflow terminology. Enforce the plain-language checker before release; construction-industry terms remain allowed.
Client-confirmed lump-sum pricing is a recorded assertion until independently reconciled; never state that an internal financial ledger was checked unless verified.

review_checks: verify legal party names and contractor/client capacities
map scope inclusions/exclusions item by item
identify drawings, measurement authority, tax and payment terms
check material responsibility, variation approvals, defects and dispute terms
reject_flags: unstated client works versus contractor works

review_checks: distinguish worker employee versus independent labour contractor
verify working hours, wage, overtime and legal entitlements
site occupational safety and tools allocation
attendance or quantity measurement and termination
verify position, duties and employment classification
verify notice, probation, leave and statutory deductions
check legally authorized signatories
separate gross, deduction and net
check payment cycle and statutory contributions
verify live payroll authority
verify dates and job title against personnel register
verify duties evidence and signatory authority
identify recommender relationship and firsthand evidence
distinguish factual attestation from subjective opinion
check subject consent and authorized disclosure
check buyer and vendor roles, offer validity and unit rates
tax and currency basis and delivery obligations
each line traced to pricing evidence
check exact tender rules and eligibility
submission deadline, forms and validity
no unsupported regulatory certification
separate problem, deliverables and acceptance criteria
scope assumptions, exclusions and schedule
proposal validity and commercial approval
takeoff only from CAD repository and verified FIDs
rate library as independent source
BOQ template not quantity authority
match units and arithmetic with checked exclusions
reject_flags: BOQ quantity generated from a rate template

review_checks: opening plus receipts minus usage equals closing
verify site and dated source records
separate PPC/OPC and other materials by material IDs
reject_flags: textual remarks substituted for material quantity

review_checks: verify supplier, quantities, taxes and delivery
budget and procurement authority
inspection and change/return terms
verify received amount and payment method
link bank/cash evidence and invoice
check receipt is not represented as tax invoice
verify recipient, payment period and gross/net
check source timesheet or payable ledger
deductions and confirmation evidence
